**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | Allowlisted (plastic-free) |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Allowlisted (EN 13432 supplier certificate) |
| "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds | Unsupported: invented testimonial, customer name and location, and a superlative. Nothing in the policy or this chat supplies it. |

**Issues**

1. The testimonial "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds has no source. Policy bans invented testimonials and customer names. It also carries a "best" superlative, which the brand never makes. Remove it. If a real, permissioned review exists, supply it with its source, and even then the "best" wording would need to be cleared by Sam.
2. Landing page consistency: the ad should only make claims the landing page also makes. Confirm the landing page carries the plastic-free and home compostable claim.
3. Wording note: the headline and description repeat each other. Not a blocker, but the description could use a real allowlisted fact instead, such as "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" or "Certified organic by the Soil Association".
4. Approval: all public content needs Sam's sign-off.
5. Character counts were not given, so I haven't checked limits. Note that the description as drafted is about 100 characters, and the headline is 22, which is within the usual 30 limit for search headlines.

**Compliant version**

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.
